skill_name: Describe the main idea of a paper about automated moderation of online discourse.
workflow: This paper examines the potential for automated moderation of online discourse. It provides an overview of existing automated moderation systems and their drawbacks, and evaluates the potential for new solutions to moderate online communities. It examines the challenges of creating a system that effectively and fairly moderates discourse, while still allowing users to freely express their opinions.
